attrs.evidence: governance/blind_run.mjs --complete + receipts/<run_id>.RESULT.json; holdout_runner.mjs --summary. Falsifier G: --complete from the wrong state is refused. Falsifier H (THE DRY RUN): two agreeing subjects at REVEALED reach COMPLETE with a result receipt. Falsifier I: one mutated artifact_root that NO frozen predicate reads is reported as an UNCLASSIFIED_FINDING and BLOCKS completion. Gate `gov-nest`.
attrs.statement: COMPLETION IS A MEASUREMENT THAT MUST SUCCEED, NOT A STATUS WORD A HUMAN TYPES. P4.7 declared REVEALED -> COMPLETE in its state table and implemented no --complete anywhere, so the terminal state was unreachable and no run could ever record a RESULT. Completion re-runs the frozen instrument over the frozen subjects and refuses unless every frozen adapter executed, every observation document validated, every conformance predicate was satisfied, interoperability was actually MEASURED across at least two implementations, and zero UNCLASSIFIED_FINDINGs are outstanding. It then writes an immutable RESULT receipt carrying the challenge commitment, every subject's package and binary digest, every observation document's digest, the predicate totals and the interop outcome -- so the measurement can be re-checked without trusting the record.
